t: After you have wronged someone or yourself
a: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
p: Wa man yaʿmal sū'an aw yaẓlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri-llāha yajidi-llāha Ghafūran Raḥīmā.
m: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allāh will find Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
